ranks.description: Call upon the Grey's shadows: camouflage, and +10 DB while stationary and shrouded.
effects: Increase DB by 10 while stationary and camouflaged

system.description: This active ability calls upon the Grey — Luclin's perpetual twilight — wrapping you in living shadow. While the shroud holds and you remain still, your Defensive Bonus rises as eyes slide past you.
